title: Title & Registration Services Packet Channel Charge on a Returned Packet
content:
When a returned Title & Registration Services packet goes back to the state, a packet channel charge is added: eighteen dollars (18.00) when the service sends packets to the buyer's county office by mail, four dollars (4.00) when the service submits electronically and a lien recording fee stands collected on the order, because the lien papers go with the electronic packet, and nothing when the service submits electronically and no lien recording fee stands collected. Kestrel funds this charge itself and adds it to the same remittance.

## Channel by service type

| Service type | Packet channel |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | electronic |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | electronic |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | electronic |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | by mail to the buyer's county office |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | by mail to the buyer's county office |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | electronic |

A lien recording fee stands collected when the title order carries a state fee entry collected under the lien recording fee.

| Packet channel | Lien recording fee entry on the order | Packet channel charge |
|---|---|---|
| by mail | either | 18.00 |
| electronic | yes | 4.00 |
| electronic | no | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A Kestrel Out-of-State Registration packet: 18.00.
- A Kestrel In-State New Registration packet on an order that collected a lien recording fee: 4.00; without one: nothing.
